reviewed_scope: M057–M077 with emphasis on M062 M063 M069 M070–M075

approved_scopes.scope: Complete equality-constrained PSD classification is correct under the stated symmetric PSD matrix and c≠0 hypotheses; nullspace feasibility and all-minimizer cases are handled. The inequality-constrained example has correct KKT slack (0,2).
Amplitude-damping solution, Kraus completeness, determinant identity and semigroup law are correct for γ≥0,t≥0. The text correctly separates complete positivity from microscopic modeling assumptions.
Lyapunov rate and exact P certificate are correct. The positive Euclidean derivative is a legitimate counterexample to the failed converse, not a contradiction to stability.

Length-coordinate and orthonormal conventions are stated. Curvature units, c powers, trace-reversal factor 1/2, Riemann sign convention and Newtonian 8π normalization are internally consistent. The regular spatial canonical count and covariant-conservation example are qualified.
Conditional Vκ construction is valid for a strongly inaccessible κ; the text does not claim existence in bare ZFC. The finite check is explicitly only an illustration.

Partition classes, exact piecewise-linear energy identity, strong H1 energy convergence and the x² formula are correct. Weak lower semicontinuity is not being advertised as a complete new continuum-limit theorem.
Reviewed remaining finite examples and proofs; found no blocking mathematical error. Numerical demonstrations are scoped as examples rather than general machine proofs.
